app.name: Rhythm
app.description: Today-first recurring reminders for the things you keep meaning to do.

login.tagline: Sign in with email. We send a one-time link — no password.
login.expired: Sign-in link expired or already used. Request a new one.
login.invalidEmail: Enter a real email address you can open.
login.disposableEmail: Temporary inboxes aren't allowed. Use an address you keep.
login.tooMany: Too many sign-in emails. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.configError: Could not send email. For Brevo, verify the sender in Settings → Senders and set BREVO_API_KEY plus EMAIL_FROM. For Resend without a domain, only your Resend account email can receive mail.
login.checkBody: We emailed a sign-in link to {{email}}.
login.checkPageBody: A sign-in link is on its way. Locally, check the terminal if you haven't set EMAIL_SERVER yet.

today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Add a recurring routine and Rhythm will bring it back when it's time.

routines.title: Routines
routines.subtitle: Recurring reminders for household, hygiene, and everything else.
routines.emptyBody: Bed sheets every week. Nails every two weeks. Haircut every month.
routines.newHint: Tell Rhythm how often this should show up on Today.

form.title: Title
form.dayOnly: Due on that day, with no clock time.
form.monthDayHint: Shorter months use the last day (31 becomes 28, 29, or 30).
form.active: Active (paused routines stop generating new reminders)

actions.confirmDelete: Delete this routine and its history?

push.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. Native apps will use the same reminder pipeline later.
push.permission: Browser permission: {{permission}}. Rhythm can ping you when something is due or overdue.
push.notConfigured: Push is not configured on the server yet.
push.blocked: Notifications were blocked for this browser.
push.enabled: Reminders are on for this device.

starters.title: Start with a few usual ones
starters.body: Tap any example to add it. You can change the schedule or delete it later.
starters.tooMany: Too many new routines. Wait a minute and try again.

bedsheets.title: Change bed sheets
bedsheets.notes: Fresh sheets make the bed feel like a reset.

nails.title: Trim nails
nails.notes: A small hygiene pass before they snag.

haircut.title: Haircut
haircut.notes: Book or remind yourself before it feels overdue.

bins.title: Take the bins out
bins.notes: Move collection night in the routine if yours is a different day.

waterFilter.title: Replace water filter
waterFilter.notes: Kitchen tap or pitcher — whatever you actually use.
